QuestInfo.name: The Last Note
QuestInfo.0: There is one more note on the #b#p617##k in #m10005070#.
QuestInfo.1: Lisel's note says #o23#s took the Lantern Party's lantern in #m10005071#. To finish their trail, I need to defeat #r30 #o23#s#k.
QuestInfo.2: I read the Lantern Party's last note. They found the giant mushroom, and it was a Mushmom. They all made it out. I pinned my own note under theirs.

0.0: (The last note was written in a hurry.)
0.1: "Day 5. #o23#s took our lantern in #m10005071#. We can't go on in the dark. We'll go back for it tomorrow, then find the mushroom. - Lisel"
0.2: (The bottom of the note is torn off. To learn how their trail ends, you will have to follow it. Will you defeat #r30 #o23#s#k in #m10005071#?)

yes.0: (You decide to finish the Lantern Party's trail. Defeat #r30 #o23#s#k in #m10005071# and the caves past it.)

no.0: (You leave the last note for now.)

1.0: (You followed the trail to its end. Back at the board, you find the torn piece of the last note, pinned under the others.)
1.1: "Day 6. We got the lantern back and found the giant mushroom, in the side cave past the park. It's no ordinary mushroom. It's a Mushmom, and it's awake."
1.2: "We ran, and we all made it out. We're going home. Whoever reads this: don't go in alone. - Toma, Lisel and Brin"
1.3: (You pin your own note under theirs: "I followed your trail. Glad you made it home.")

mob.0: (The #r#o23#s#k are still in the caves. Defeat #r30#k of them first.)
